jobs.title: Private Assets Investment Analyst
jobs.description:
A career at Lombard Odier means working for a renowned global wealth and asset manager, with a strong focus on sustainable investing. An innovative bank of choice for private and institutional clients, our independently owned Firm is one of the best-capitalised banking groups in the world, managing close to CHF 300 billion and operating from over 25 offices across 4 continents.

With a history spanning over 225 years, Lombard Odier is an investment house providing a comprehensive offering of discretionary and advisory portfolio management, wealth services and custody. We also offer asset management services and investment strategies through Lombard Odier Investment Managers and provide advanced banking technology to other financial institutions.

“Rethink Everything” is our philosophy – it is at the heart of everything we do. We have grown stronger through more than 40 financial crises by rethinking the world around us to provide a fresh investment perspective for our clients.

Lombard Odier Investment Managers (“LOIM”) is the asset management business of the Lombard Odier Group. In order to strengthen our Private Assets department, we are looking for a Geneva based:

Investment Analyst- Private Assets

As an Investment Analyst, you will work closely with Investment Managers and broader team members across all stages of the private equity investment cycle, contributing to the sourcing, assessment, and monitoring of private asset opportunities

YOUR ROLE

• Maintain and update the private assets fund opportunity pipeline

• Analyse new private equity fund investments, co‑investments/directs, industry trends, and market dynamics

• Perform detailed due diligence on investment opportunities, including qualitative and quantitative analysis

• Prepare investment memoranda, due diligence documentation, and internal committee materials

• Monitor and report on existing fund investments, providing in‑depth performance insights

• Support the preparation of marketing materials for LOIM private equity strategies and products

• Develop sales pitches, presentations, and other materials for internal and external stakeholders

YOUR PROFILE

• Master’s degree, ideally in business, economics, finance, or engineering

• Prior professional experience in Private Equity, Corporate Finance, or Investment Banking is essential

• Native-level proficiency in English; professional working proficiency in French

• Strong analytical and problem‑solving skills, with excellent attention to detail

• Proactive, innovative, and results‑driven mindset

• Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic environment and manage multiple priorities

• Outstanding interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to work both independently and collaboratively

Our Maison’s DNA is defined by five core values. Excellence drives us to be the best at what we do, while Innovation fuels our progress. Respect underpins every interaction, and Integrity shapes our actions. Together, we are One Team , united in serving our clients with unwavering dedication.

As a responsible and supportive employer, we promote a diverse and inclusive work environment for our employees and candidates. Diversity, Equity and Inclusion are woven into the fabric of our Maison’s DNA, and we strive to ensure that our employees can fulfill both their personal and professional aspirations by encouraging internal mobility and individual upskilling programs. We firmly believe that building Diverse Teams contributes to our successes and to deliver on this, we actively embed Diversity, Equity and Inclusion in our business strategy.

It is an exciting time to join our Teams. All applications will be handled in the strictest confidence.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Una carriera a Lombard Odier significa lavorare per un rinomato asset manager globale, con un forte focus sugli investimenti sostenibili. Un'innovativa banca di scelta per clienti privati e istituzionali, il nostro Studio indipendente di proprietà è uno dei gruppi bancari più capitalizzati al mondo, che gestisce quasi 300 miliardi di franchi e opera da oltre 25 uffici in 4 continenti. Con una storia di oltre 225 anni, Lombard Odier è una casa di investimento che offre un'offerta completa di gestione del portafoglio discrezionale e consultivo, servizi di ricchezza e custodia. Offriamo anche servizi di asset management e strategie di investimento attraverso Lombard Odier Investment Manager e fornire tecnologia bancaria avanzata ad altre istituzioni finanziarie. “Rethink Everything” è la nostra filosofia – è al centro di tutto ciò che facciamo. Siamo cresciuti più forti attraverso più di 40 crisi finanziarie ripensando il mondo intorno a noi per fornire una nuova prospettiva di investimento per i nostri clienti. Lombard Odier Investment Managers (“LOIM”) è l’attività di gestione patrimoniale del Gruppo Lombard Odier. Al fine di rafforzare il nostro dipartimento di beni privati, stiamo cercando una base di Ginevra: Investimenti Analisti - Beni privati In qualità di Investment Analyst, lavorerai a stretto contatto con Investment Manager e membri del team più ampi in tutte le fasi del ciclo di investimento azionario privato, contribuendo all'apprezzamento, alla valutazione e al monitoraggio delle opportunità di asset privati Il tuo!
• Mantenere e aggiornare l'opportunitÃ del fondo patrimoniale privato
• Analizzare nuovi investimenti privati, co-investimenti/direzioni, tendenze del settore e dinamiche di mercato
• Eseguire la dovuta diligenza dettagliata sulle opportunità di investimento, tra cui l'analisi qualitativa e quantitativa
• Preparare la memoranda degli investimenti, la documentazione di due diligence e i materiali dei comitati interni
• Monitorare e segnalare gli investimenti dei fondi esistenti, fornendo approfondimenti sulle prestazioni
• Sostenere la preparazione di materiali di marketing per LOIM strategie private equity e prodotti
• Sviluppare campi di vendita, presentazioni e altri materiali per gli stakeholder interni ed esterni Il tuo progetto
• Laurea magistrale, idealmente in economia, economia, finanza o ingegneria
• Prima esperienza professionale in Private Equity, Corporate Finance o Investment Banking è essenziale
• Competenza di livello nativo in inglese; competenza professionale in francese
• Forte capacità analitiche e di problem solving, con ottima attenzione ai dettagli
• Set mentale proattivo, innovativo e guidato dai risultati
• Capacità di prosperare in un ambiente dinamico e veloce e gestire più priorità
• Competenze interpersonali e di comunicazione eccezionali, con la capacità di lavorare in modo indipendente e collaborativo Il DNA della nostra Maison è definito da cinque valori fondamentali. L'eccellenza ci spinge ad essere i migliori a quello che facciamo, mentre l'innovazione alimenta i nostri progressi. Il rispetto sostiene ogni interazione, e l'integrità plasma le nostre azioni. Insieme, siamo un team unico, uniti nel servire i nostri clienti con dedizione inaspettata. Come datore di lavoro responsabile e di supporto, promuoviamo un ambiente di lavoro diversificato e inclusivo per i nostri dipendenti e candidati. Diversità, equità e inclusione sono intrecciati nel tessuto del DNA della nostra Maison, e ci sforziamo di garantire che i nostri dipendenti possano soddisfare sia le loro aspirazioni personali che professionali incoraggiando la mobilità interna e programmi di upskilling individuali. Crediamo fermamente che la costruzione di Diverse Teams contribuisca ai nostri successi e a fornire su questo, abbiamo attivamente incorporato Diversità, Equità e Inclusione nella nostra strategia aziendale. E' un momento emozionante per unirsi ai nostri team. Tutte le applicazioni saranno gestite nella massima fiducia.

descriptionByLocale.de:
Eine Karriere bei Lombard Odier bedeutet, für einen renommierten globalen Vermögens- und Vermögensverwalter mit einem starken Fokus auf nachhaltige Investitionen zu arbeiten. Eine innovative Bank der Wahl für private und institutionelle Kunden, unser unabhängiger Eigentümer Firm ist eine der besten Bankengruppen der Welt, die in der Nähe von CHF 300 Milliarden verwaltet und von über 25 Büros auf 4 Kontinenten. Lombard Odier ist mit einer über 225 Jahre langen Geschichte ein Investmenthaus, das ein umfassendes Angebot an diskreten und beratenden Portfolio-Management, Vermögensdienstleistungen und Sorge bietet. Wir bieten auch Asset-Management-Dienste und Anlagestrategien durch Lombard Odier Investment Manager und bieten fortschrittliche Banktechnologie an andere Finanzinstitute. „Rethink Everything“ ist unsere Philosophie – es liegt im Herzen von allem, was wir tun. Wir sind durch mehr als 40 Finanzkrisen stärker gewachsen, indem wir die Welt um uns herum neu denken, um unseren Kunden eine neue Investitionsperspektive zu bieten. Lombard Odier Investment Manager ("LOIM") ist das Asset Management-Geschäft der Lombard Odier Gruppe. Um unsere Private Assets-Abteilung zu stärken, suchen wir einen Genfer Standort: Investment Analyst- Private Assets Als Investment Analyst arbeiten Sie eng mit Investment Managern und weiteren Teammitgliedern in allen Phasen des Private-Equity-Investitionszyklus zusammen und tragen zur Beschaffung, Bewertung und Überwachung von privaten Asset-Möglichkeiten bei IHRE ROLLE
• Erhaltung und Aktualisierung der Möglichkeiten des privaten Fonds
• Neue Private Equity-Fonds-Investitionen, Co‐Investments/Direkte, Branchentrends und Marktdynamik analysieren
• Durchführung detaillierter Due Diligence auf Investitionsmöglichkeiten, einschließlich qualitativer und quantitativer Analysen
• Vorbereitung von Investitionsgedächtnis, Due Diligence Dokumentation und interne Ausschussmaterialien
• Überwachen und Bericht über bestehende Fondsinvestitionen, die umfassende Leistungseinsichten bieten
• Unterstützung der Vorbereitung von Marketingmaterialien für LOIM Private Equity Strategien und Produkte
• Entwicklung von Verkaufsstellen, Präsentationen und anderen Materialien für interne und externe Akteure IHRE PROFILE
• Masterstudium, ideal in Wirtschaft, Finanzen oder Ingenieurwesen
• Vorherige Berufserfahrung in Private Equity, Corporate Finance oder Investment Banking ist unerlässlich
• Native-Level-Proficiency in englischer Sprache; professionelle Arbeitsfähigkeit auf Französisch
• Starke analytische und problemlösende Fähigkeiten, mit ausgezeichneter Liebe zum Detail
• Proaktive, innovative und ergebnisorientierte Denkweise
• Fähigkeit, in einem schnelllebigen, dynamischen Umfeld zu leben und mehrere Prioritäten zu verwalten
• Herausragende zwischenmenschliche und kommunikative Fähigkeiten mit der Fähigkeit, unabhängig und kollaborativ zu arbeiten Die DNA unseres Hauses wird durch fünf Kernwerte definiert. Exzellenz treibt uns dazu, das Beste zu sein, während Innovation unseren Fortschritt vorantreibt. Respekt unterstützt jede Interaktion und Integrität prägt unsere Handlungen. Gemeinsam sind wir ein Team, vereint in der Betreuung unserer Kunden mit unerschütterlicher Hingabe. Als verantwortungsbewusster und unterstützender Arbeitgeber fördern wir ein vielfältiges und inklusives Arbeitsumfeld für unsere Mitarbeiter und Kandidaten. Diversity, Equity und Inclusion sind in den Stoff unserer Maison’s DNA gewebt, und wir bemühen uns, sicherzustellen, dass unsere Mitarbeiter ihre persönlichen und beruflichen Bestrebungen erfüllen können, indem wir interne Mobilität und individuelle Upskilling-Programme fördern. Wir sind fest davon überzeugt, dass der Aufbau von Diverse Teams zu unseren Erfolgen beiträgt und dass wir darauf aktiv Diversity, Equity und Inclusion in unsere Geschäftsstrategie einbetten. Es ist eine aufregende Zeit, sich unseren Teams anzuschließen. Alle Anwendungen werden im strengsten Vertrauen behandelt.
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Une carrière chez Lombard Odier signifie travailler pour un gérant mondial de patrimoine et d'actifs renommé, avec un accent fort sur l'investissement durable. Banque innovante de choix pour les clients privés et institutionnels, notre entreprise indépendante est l'un des groupes bancaires les mieux capitalisés au monde, gérant près de CHF 300 milliards et opérant depuis plus de 25 bureaux sur 4 continents. Avec une histoire de plus de 225 ans, Lombard Odier est une maison d'investissement offrant une offre complète de gestion de portefeuille discrétionnaire et consultative, de services de patrimoine et de garde. Nous offrons également des services de gestion d'actifs et des stratégies d'investissement par l'intermédiaire de Lombard Odier Investment Managers et fournissons une technologie bancaire avancée à d'autres institutions financières. Repensez Tout est notre philosophie – elle est au cœur de tout ce que nous faisons. Nous sommes devenus plus forts grâce à plus de 40 crises financières en repensant le monde qui nous entoure pour offrir une nouvelle perspective d'investissement à nos clients. Lombard Odier Investment Managers est une entreprise de gestion d'actifs du groupe Lombard Odier. Afin de renforcer notre département des actifs privés, nous recherchons une base Genève : Analyste des investissements - Actifs privés En tant qu'analyste des investissements, vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec les gestionnaires des investissements et les membres de l'équipe à toutes les étapes du cycle d'investissement en capital-investissement, contribuant ainsi à l'approvisionnement, à l'évaluation et au suivi des possibilités d'acquisition d'actifs privés Votre rôle
• Maintenir et mettre à jour le portefeuille d'opportunités de fonds d'actifs privés
• Analyser les nouveaux investissements des fonds de capital-investissement, les co-investissements/directs, les tendances de l'industrie et la dynamique du marché
• Effectuer une diligence raisonnable détaillée sur les possibilités d'investissement, y compris une analyse qualitative et quantitative
• Préparer des mémorandums d'investissement, de la documentation sur la diligence raisonnable et du matériel de comité interne
• Surveiller les investissements existants et en rendre compte, en fournissant des informations approfondies sur le rendement
• Soutenir la préparation de matériel de marketing pour les stratégies et produits de fonds propres LOIM
• Développer des emplacements de vente, des présentations et d'autres matériaux pour les parties prenantes internes et externes VOTRE PROFIL
• Maîtrise, idéalement en affaires, économie, finance ou ingénierie
• Une expérience professionnelle préalable en Private Equity, Corporate Finance ou Investment Banking est essentielle
• Compétences des autochtones en anglais; compétences professionnelles en français
• Fortes compétences d'analyse et de résolution de problèmes, avec une excellente attention aux détails
• Une mentalité proactive, innovante et axée sur les résultats
• Capacité de prospérer dans un environnement dynamique et rapide et de gérer de multiples priorités
• Compétences interpersonnelles et de communication exceptionnelles, avec la capacité de travailler de manière indépendante et en collaboration L'ADN de la Maison est défini par cinq valeurs fondamentales. L'excellence nous pousse à être les meilleurs dans ce que nous faisons, tandis que l'innovation alimente nos progrès. Le respect sous-tend chaque interaction, et l'intégrité façonne nos actions. Ensemble, nous sommes une équipe, unie pour servir nos clients avec un dévouement inébranlable. En tant qu'employeur responsable et solidaire, nous favorisons un milieu de travail diversifié et inclusif pour nos employés et nos candidats. Diversité, équité et inclusion sont tissés dans le tissu de notre ADN Maison, et nous nous efforçons de faire en sorte que nos employés puissent réaliser leurs aspirations personnelles et professionnelles en encourageant la mobilité interne et les programmes de perfectionnement individuel. Nous croyons fermement que la création d'équipes diversifiées contribue à nos succès et pour y parvenir, nous intégrons activement la diversité, l'équité et l'inclusion dans notre stratégie d'affaires. C'est un moment passionnant de rejoindre nos équipes. Toutes les demandes seront traitées avec la plus grande confiance.

Our Southern Europe & Latin America (SELA) region is seeking a Head of Spain to lead and develop our Swiss-based teams serving Spanish clients.
This strategic leadership role will offer significant scope to shape the business, drive growth, and contribute to broader regional initiatives within a highly international environment.

• Lead and develop the Spain teams based in Geneva and Zurich, ensuring strong performance and engagement within the bank’s strategy.

• Define and execute a strategic business plan, including commercial initiatives, market positioning, and revenue growth.

• Coach and develop Private Bankers while attracting and retaining top talent.

• Drive business performance, including team and individual KPIs, revenue growth, and Net New Money generation.

• Ensure excellence in risk management and compliance, maintaining the highest standards.

• Act as a member of the SELA Executive Committee, contributing to broader regional strategy and decision-making.

• Strengthen market intelligence on Spain and identify opportunities for innovation and growth.

• Design and coordinate tailored offerings and initiatives for Spanish clients across locations and regional markets

YOUR PROFILE

• Minimum 10 years’ relevant experience within the banking industry.

• Proven leadership capabilities, with potential for wider scope and evolution. Ability to inspire, develop, and scale teams.

• Strong commercial mindset with a track record of growing client relationships and revenues.

• Ability to demonstrate personal initiative, ownership, accountability and entrepreneurship.

• Ability to attract, recruit and develop talented and skilled professionals.

• Strategic thinker with the capacity to operate both hands-on and at a broader leadership level.

Eine innovative Bank der Wahl für private und institutionelle Kunden, unser unabhängiger Eigentümer Firm ist eine der besten Bankengruppen der Welt, die in der Nähe von CHF 300 Milliarden verwaltet und von über 25 Büros auf 4 Kontinenten. Lombard Odier ist mit einer über 230-jährigen Geschichte ein Investmenthaus, das ein umfassendes Angebot an diskreten und beratenden Portfolio-Management, Vermögensdienstleistungen und Sorge bietet. Wir bieten auch Asset-Management-Dienste und Anlagestrategien durch Lombard Odier Investment Manager und bieten fortschrittliche Banktechnologie an andere Finanzinstitute. „Rethink Everything“ ist unsere Philosophie – es liegt im Herzen von allem, was wir tun. Wir sind durch mehr als 40 Finanzkrisen stärker gewachsen, indem wir die Welt um uns herum neu denken, um unseren Kunden eine neue Investitionsperspektive zu bieten. Unsere Region Südeuropa & Lateinamerika (SELA) sucht einen Leiter Spaniens, um unsere Schweizer Teams zu leiten und zu entwickeln, die spanischen Kunden dienen. Diese strategische Führungsrolle bietet einen erheblichen Umfang, um das Unternehmen zu formen, Wachstum zu fördern und zu breiteren regionalen Initiativen in einem hochinternationalen Umfeld beizutragen. IHRE ROLLE
• Führen und entwickeln Sie die spanischen Teams mit Sitz in Genf und Zürich, um eine starke Leistung und Engagement in der Strategie der Bank sicherzustellen.
• Festlegung und Durchführung eines strategischen Geschäftsplans, einschließlich kommerzieller Initiativen, Marktpositionierung und Umsatzwachstum.
• Coach und entwickeln Private Bankers und gewinnen und halten Top-Talent.
• Führen Sie die Geschäftsentwicklung, einschließlich Team und individuelle Kennzahlen, Umsatzwachstum und Net New Money Generation.
• Gewährleistung von Exzellenz im Risikomanagement und Compliance und Einhaltung der höchsten Standards.
• Gesetz als Mitglied des SELA-Exekutivkomitees und trägt zur breiteren regionalen Strategie und Entscheidungsfindung bei.
• Stärkung der Marktintelligenz in Spanien und Identifizierung von Innovations- und Wachstumsmöglichkeiten.
• Gestalten und koordinieren Sie maßgeschneiderte Angebote und Initiativen für spanische Kunden an Standorten und regionalen Märkten IHRE PROFILE
• Mindestens 10 Jahre relevante Erfahrungen in der Bankenbranche.
• Bewährte Führungsfähigkeiten, mit Potenzial für größere Reichweite und Entwicklung. Fähigkeit, Teams zu inspirieren, zu entwickeln und zu skalieren.
• Starke kommerzielle Denkweise mit einer Spur von wachsenden Kundenbeziehungen und Einnahmen.
• Fähigkeit, persönliche Initiative, Eigentum, Verantwortlichkeit und Unternehmertum zu demonstrieren.
• Fähigkeit, talentierte und qualifizierte Fachkräfte zu gewinnen, zu rekrutieren und zu entwickeln.
• Strategischer Denker mit der Fähigkeit, sowohl Hand-on als auch auf einer breiteren Führungsebene zu betreiben.
• Fluent geschrieben und gesprochen Spanisch und Englisch, Französisch und andere relevante Sprachen ein Vermögen. Die DNA unseres Hauses wird durch fünf Kernwerte definiert. Exzellenz treibt uns dazu, das Beste zu sein, während Innovation unseren Fortschritt vorantreibt. Respekt unterstützt jede Interaktion und Integrität prägt unsere Handlungen. Gemeinsam sind wir ein Team, vereint in der Betreuung unserer Kunden mit unerschütterlicher Hingabe. Als verantwortungsbewusster und unterstützender Arbeitgeber fördern wir ein vielfältiges und inklusives Arbeitsumfeld für unsere Mitarbeiter und Kandidaten. Diversity, Equity und Inclusion sind in den Stoff unserer Maison’s DNA gewebt, und wir bemühen uns, sicherzustellen, dass unsere Mitarbeiter ihre persönlichen und beruflichen Bestrebungen erfüllen können, indem wir interne Mobilität und individuelle Upskilling-Programme fördern. Wir sind fest davon überzeugt, dass der Aufbau von Diverse Teams zu unseren Erfolgen beiträgt und dass wir darauf aktiv Diversity, Equity und Inclusion in unsere Geschäftsstrategie einbetten. Es ist eine aufregende Zeit, sich unseren Teams anzuschließen. Alle Anwendungen werden im strengsten Vertrauen behandelt.
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Une carrière chez Lombard Odier signifie travailler pour un gérant mondial de patrimoine et d'actifs renommé, avec un accent fort sur l'investissement durable. Banque innovante de choix pour les clients privés et institutionnels, notre entreprise indépendante est l'un des groupes bancaires les mieux capitalisés au monde, gérant près de CHF 300 milliards et opérant depuis plus de 25 bureaux sur 4 continents. Avec une histoire de plus de 230 ans, Lombard Odier est une maison d'investissement offrant une offre complète de gestion de portefeuille discrétionnaire et consultative, de services de patrimoine et de garde. Nous offrons également des services de gestion d'actifs et des stratégies d'investissement par l'intermédiaire de Lombard Odier Investment Managers et fournissons une technologie bancaire avancée à d'autres institutions financières. Repensez Tout est notre philosophie – elle est au cœur de tout ce que nous faisons. Nous sommes devenus plus forts grâce à plus de 40 crises financières en repensant le monde qui nous entoure pour offrir une nouvelle perspective d'investissement à nos clients. Notre région Europe du Sud et Amérique Latine (SELA) cherche un Chef d'Espagne pour diriger et développer nos équipes suisses au service de clients espagnols. Ce rôle de leadership stratégique offrira une marge de manoeuvre importante pour façonner l'entreprise, stimuler la croissance et contribuer à des initiatives régionales plus vastes dans un environnement international très élevé. Votre rôle
• Diriger et développer les équipes espagnoles basées à Genève et Zurich, en assurant une forte performance et un engagement au sein de la stratégie de la banque.
• Définir et exécuter un plan d'affaires stratégique comprenant des initiatives commerciales, le positionnement du marché et la croissance des recettes.
• Coach et développer des banquiers privés tout en attirant et en conservant les meilleurs talents.
• Diriger la performance des entreprises, y compris l'équipe et les KPI individuels, la croissance des revenus, et la génération nette de nouveaux fonds.
• Assurer l'excellence dans la gestion des risques et la conformité, en maintenant les normes les plus élevées.
• Agir en tant que membre du Comité exécutif du SELA, contribuant ainsi à une stratégie régionale plus large et à la prise de décisions.
• Renforcer l'information commerciale sur l'Espagne et identifier les possibilités d'innovation et de croissance.
• Concevoir et coordonner des offres et des initiatives sur mesure pour les clients espagnols à travers les sites et les marchés régionaux VOTRE PROFIL
• Au moins 10 ans d'expérience pertinente dans le secteur bancaire.
• Des capacités de leadership éprouvées, avec un potentiel d'élargissement et d'évolution. Capacité d'inspirer, de développer et d'améliorer les équipes.
• L'esprit commercial fort avec un record de relations avec les clients et de revenus croissants.
• Capacité de démontrer l'initiative personnelle, la propriété, la responsabilité et l'esprit d'entreprise.
• Capacité d'attirer, de recruter et de développer des professionnels talentueux et qualifiés.
• Un penseur stratégique ayant la capacité d'opérer à la fois sur le terrain et à un niveau de leadership plus large.
• L'espagnol et l'anglais, le français et d'autres langues pertinentes sont un atout. L'ADN de la Maison est défini par cinq valeurs fondamentales. L'excellence nous pousse à être les meilleurs dans ce que nous faisons, tandis que l'innovation alimente nos progrès. Le respect sous-tend chaque interaction, et l'intégrité façonne nos actions. Ensemble, nous sommes une équipe, unie pour servir nos clients avec un dévouement inébranlable. En tant qu'employeur responsable et solidaire, nous favorisons un milieu de travail diversifié et inclusif pour nos employés et nos candidats. Diversité, équité et inclusion sont tissés dans le tissu de notre ADN Maison, et nous nous efforçons de faire en sorte que nos employés puissent réaliser leurs aspirations personnelles et professionnelles en encourageant la mobilité interne et les programmes de perfectionnement individuel. Nous croyons fermement que la création d'équipes diversifiées contribue à nos succès et pour y parvenir, nous intégrons activement la diversité, l'équité et l'inclusion dans notre stratégie d'affaires. C'est un moment passionnant de rejoindre nos équipes. Toutes les demandes seront traitées avec la plus grande confiance.

jobs.title: Senior Trust Relationship Manager (80-100%)

titleByLocale.fr: Gestionnaire principal des relations de confiance (80-100%)

jobs.description:
A career at Lombard Odier means working for a renowned global wealth and asset manager, with a strong focus on sustainable investing. An innovative bank of choice for private and institutional clients, our independently owned Firm is one of the best-capitalised banking groups in the world, managing close to CHF 300 billion and operating from over 25 offices across 4 continents.

With a history spanning over 230 years, Lombard Odier is an investment house providing a comprehensive offering of discretionary and advisory portfolio management, wealth services and custody. We also offer asset management services and investment strategies through Lombard Odier Investment Managers and provide advanced banking technology to other financial institutions.

“Rethink Everything” is our philosophy – it is at the heart of everything we do. We have grown stronger through more than 40 financial crises by rethinking the world around us to provide a fresh investment perspective for our clients.

Senior Trust Relationship Manager (80-100%)
Private Clients – Wealth Planning

Lombard Odier Trust (Bermuda) Limited is seeking a Senior Trust Relationship Manager (STRM) to oversee a portfolio of international private client structures. This role combines client relationship management, trust administration oversight, and team coordination within a multicultural environment, ensuring high fiduciary, regulatory, and governance standards.

YOUR ROLE

Client Relationship & Trust Administration

• Act as primary contact for a portfolio of international private client structures.

• Manage relationships with clients, advisors, family offices, and internal stakeholders across jurisdictions.

• Oversee daily administration activities (distributions, transactions, resolutions, bank relationships, reviews, regulatory reporting such as CRS/FATCA).

• Ensure compliance with legal, tax, and regulatory requirements.

• Review financial statements, maintain accurate records, and monitor client billing.

• Support business development, onboarding, and risk assessment processes.

Governance & Operations

• Contribute to reporting, audits, risk monitoring, and fiduciary strategy.

• Maintain and enhance policies, procedures, and internal controls.

• Monitor KPIs, fee governance, and operational efficiency improvements.

• Collaborate with stakeholders and represent the business in committees and industry forums.

Senior & Team Responsibilities

• Provide technical guidance and oversight on complex trust matters.

• Support work allocation, team coordination, and service delivery quality.

• Identify and manage operational and fiduciary risks.

• Mentor team members and promote best practices, strong compliance culture, and consistent service standards.

YOUR PROFILE

• TEP qualification (or equivalent) with 10+ years’ experience in trust administration or fiduciary services.

• Strong exposure to UHNW private clients and private banking environment.

• Proven ability to manage complex international client relationships with diplomacy and sound judgment.

• Solid understanding of fiduciary structures, risk management, and regulatory frameworks.

• Strong organisational, communication, and commercial skills.

• Fluent in English.

Additional skills (minimum three)

• French proficiency

• Wealth/tax planning or corporate secretary experience

• Knowledge of Viewpoint or similar systems

• Exposure to audit, compliance, or governance committees

• Experience in process improvement or transformation initiatives

• Strong cultural awareness and international exposure

• Expertise in governance, dispute resolution, or presentation of complex topics

Our Maison’s DNA is defined by five core values. Excellence drives us to be the best at what we do, while Innovation fuels our progress. Respect underpins every interaction, and Integrity shapes our actions. Together, we are One Team , united in serving our clients with unwavering dedication.

As a responsible and supportive

We also offer asset management services and investment strategies through Lombard Odier Investment Managers and provide advanced banking technology to other financial institutions.

“Rethink Everything” is our philosophy – it is at the heart of everything we do. We have grown stronger through more than 40 financial crises by rethinking the world around us to provide a fresh investment perspective for our clients.

Private Banking Assistant - Swiss Domestic - Vevey (80-100%)

Au sein de notre bureau de Vevey, nous recherchons un(e) Assistant(e) de Gestion pour soutenir notre équipe Swiss Domestic. Vous ferez partie d'une équipe dynamique et travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec les banquiers privés. Vous devrez fournir des services de qualité pour les clients et assurer la fluidité des processus.

VOTRE MISSION

Traiter l’ensemble des questions administratives liées au suivi rigoureux des dossiers et en assurer le suivi complet :

• Fournir directement aux clients les informations sur l'évaluation du portefeuille, les soldes de comptes, les opérations, etc.

• Traiter les opérations courantes (ordres de transfert et de bourse, opérations sur titres, gestion des échéances, retraits d’espèces, accès aux coffres), tout en assurant l’accueil des clients et la gestion de la caisse.

• Appuyer les banquiers dans la préparation et la réalisation de reportings personnalisés.

• Développer un réseau interne solide et assurer la coordination avec les fournisseurs de services internes afin de garantir des réponses rapides et fiables aux demandes des clients, dans une logique d’efficacité opérationnelle et de support optimal.

• Préparer les formulaires d'ouverture de compte et traiter les ouvertures/fermetures de compte tout en respectant les processus/politiques internes strictes de la banque.

Contribuer aux initiatives commerciales des équipes :

• Préparer les rapports d'investissement des clients et les présentations sur mesure pour les activités de développement des affaires.

• Aider les banquiers privés à produire le matériel de présentation à destination des clients.

• Assister les banquiers privés dans l'organisation d'événements et/ou d'initiatives marketing dédiés.

Répondre aux exigences de Lombard Odier :

• Comprendre le cadre de gestion des risques de Lombard Odier et se familiariser avec les responsabilités en matière de risques au sein des équipes.

• Se conformer à toutes les exigences légales, réglementaires et internes applicables en matière de conformité, y compris, mais sans s'y limiter, le manuel de conformité du bureau local et les politiques et procédures de conformité publiées de temps à autre.

• Maintenir des connaissances appropriées pour s'assurer que vous êtes pleinement qualifié pour assumer le rôle. Compléter toute la formation obligatoire requise pour acquérir et maintenir la compétence.

• Se familiariser avec l'ADN et les valeurs de Lombard Odier et les respecter en tout temps.

VOTRE PROFIL

• Formation économique ou bancaire (Diplôme de l’Ecole de Commerce, CFC ou équivalent), HEC, HEG.

• Minimum 5 ans d’expérience dans le domaine bancaire, idéalement dans une fonction similaire.

• Maitrise avancée de la suite Microsoft Office, notamment Excel et Powerpoint (suivi de tableaux complexes, création de présentations et reportings…).

• Maitrise parfaite du français et de l’anglais, l'espagnol et l'allemand sont des atouts.

• Bonne

descriptionByLocale.it:
Una carriera in Lombard Odier significa lavorare per un rinomato gestore patrimoniale e patrimoniale globale, con una forte attenzione agli investimenti sostenibili. Con una storia che dura da oltre 230 anni, Lombard Odier è una casa di investimento che offre un'offerta completa di gestione di portafoglio discrezionale e di consulenza, servizi patrimoniali e custodia. jobs.description:
A career at Lombard Odier means working for a renowned global wealth and asset manager, with a strong focus on sustainable investing. An innovative bank of choice for private and institutional clients, our independently owned Firm is one of the best-capitalised banking groups in the world, managing close to CHF 300 billion and operating from over 25 offices across 4 continents.

With a history spanning over 230 years, Lombard Odier is an investment house providing a comprehensive offering of discretionary and advisory portfolio management, wealth services and custody. We also offer asset management services and investment strategies through Lombard Odier Investment Managers and provide advanced banking technology to other financial institutions.

“Rethink Everything” is our philosophy – it is at the heart of everything we do. We have grown stronger through more than 40 financial crises by rethinking the world around us to provide a fresh investment perspective for our clients.

IT Internal Auditor (80-100%)

YOUR ROLE:

As an IT Internal Auditor, you will play a key role in assessing and enhancing the governance, security, and control environment of the organization’s information systems. Your key responsibilities will include:

• Conduct and support IT audit engagements focused on IT governance, application controls, and IT general controls (ITGC).

• Lead or contribute to reviews of IT security, IT governance frameworks, identity and access management, and IT project implementations.

• Contribute to business audit missions by providing a complementary IT perspective that enhances risk coverage and the relevance of audit insights.

• Develop and implement data analytics tools to enhance audit efficiency and effectiveness, including for risk assessment purposes.

• Prepare high-quality audit reports and present findings to senior management and relevant committees.

• Monitor the implementation of audit recommendations and follow up on remediation actions.

• Contribute to the development of the annual audit plan and support continuous improvement initiatives within the Internal Audit function.

• Contribute to knowledge sharing within the team.

YOUR PROFILE:

To succeed in this role, you should bring the following qualifications and attributes:

• Master’s degree or engineering degree in Information Technology, Information Systems Management, or a related field.

• Minimum of 5 years of professional experience in IT, IS management, or IT security.

• Strong technical background, with solid understanding of multiple technology domains including Windows, UNIX/Linux, databases, networking, software development, and cloud architecture.

• Ability to translate technical risks into business-relevant insights for non-technical stakeholders.

• Proven analytical and problem-solving skills, with a critical mindset and attention to detail.

• Professional certifications such as CISA, CISSP, CISM, CRISC, or equivalent are highly valued.

• Familiarity with frameworks and standards such as ISO 27001, COBIT, NIST, and RISK IT.

• Good understanding of regulatory requirements (e.g., GDPR, Swiss Data Protection Law, FINMA circulars, etc.).

• Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal, in English and French. Ability to engage effectively with diverse stakeholders.

• Naturally curious, self-driven, and able to work both independently and collaboratively.

• Willingness to travel occasionally for audit missions.

• Swiss domicile is mandatory.

Our Maison’s DNA is defined by five core values. Excellence drives us to be the best at what we do, while Innovation fuels our progress. Respect underpins every interaction, and Integrity shapes our actions. Together, we are One Team , united in serving our clients with unwavering dedication.

As a responsible and supportive employer, we promote a diverse and inclusive work environment for our employees and candidates. Diversity, Equity and Inclusion are woven into the fabric of our Mai

Le tue responsabilità chiave includono:
• Condurre e sostenere gli impegni di audit IT focalizzati sulla governance IT, sui controlli delle applicazioni e sui controlli generali IT (ITGC).

• Minimo 5 anni di esperienza professionale in IT, IS management, o sicurezza IT.
• Forte background tecnico, con solida comprensione di più domini tecnologici tra cui Windows, UNIX/Linux, database, networking, sviluppo software e architettura cloud.
• Capacità di tradurre rischi tecnici in insight rilevanti per le imprese per gli stakeholder non tecnici.
• Prove abilità analitiche e problem solving, con una mentalità critica e attenzione ai dettagli.
• Certificazioni professionali come CISA, CISSP, CISM, CRISC o equivalente sono altamente apprezzate.
• Familiarità con i framework e gli standard quali ISO 27001, COBIT, NIST e RISK IT.
• Buona comprensione dei requisiti normativi (per esempio, GDPR, Swiss Data Protection Law, FINMA circolari, ecc.).
• Eccellente capacità di comunicazione, sia scritta che verbale, in inglese e francese. Capacità di impegnarsi efficacemente con diversi stakeholder.
• Naturalmente curioso, self-driven e in grado di lavorare in modo indipendente e collaborativo.
• Volontà di viaggiare occasionalmente per le missioni di audit.
• Il domicilio svizzero è obbligatorio. Il DNA della nostra Maison è definito da cinque valori fondamentali. L'eccellenza ci spinge ad essere i migliori a quello che facciamo, mentre l'innovazione alimenta i nostri progressi. Il rispetto sostiene ogni interazione, e l'integrità plasma le nostre azioni. Insieme, siamo un team unico, uniti nel servire i nostri clienti con dedizione inaspettata. Come datore di lavoro responsabile e di supporto, promuoviamo un ambiente di lavoro diversificato e inclusivo per i nostri dipendenti e candidati. Diversità, Equità e Inclusione sono tessuti nel tessuto del nostro Mai

jobs.title: Chef(fe) de partie
jobs.description:
A career at Lombard Odier means working for a renowned global wealth and asset manager, with a strong focus on sustainable investing. An innovative bank of choice for private and institutional clients, our independently owned Firm is one of the best-capitalised banking groups in the world, managing close to CHF 300 billion and operating from over 25 offices across 4 continents.

With a history spanning over 230 years, Lombard Odier is an investment house providing a comprehensive offering of discretionary and advisory portfolio management, wealth services and custody. We also offer asset management services and investment strategies through Lombard Odier Investment Managers and provide advanced banking technology to other financial institutions.

“Rethink Everything” is our philosophy – it is at the heart of everything we do. We have grown stronger through more than 40 financial crises by rethinking the world around us to provide a fresh investment perspective for our clients.

Chef de partie

VOTRE MISSION :

• Assurer en autonomie la gestion complète d’un poste de cuisine, de la mise en place à l’envoi.

• Préparer et réaliser les plats selon les recettes, les standards de qualité et les directives du chef de cuisine.

• Organiser la mise en place quotidienne : préparation des produits, anticipation des besoins, coordination avec l’équipe.

• Participer activement à l’envoi : dressage, rigueur et synchronisation avec les autres postes.

• Appliquer strictement les normes HACCP selon les procédures internes.

• Réceptionner et contrôler les marchandises, assurer un stockage conforme et une bonne rotation des produits.

• Contribuer à la gestion des stocks et remonter les besoins au chef de cuisine.

• Maintenir un haut niveau de propreté du poste et participer à l’entretien général de la cuisine.

• Accompagner les nouveaux collaborateurs, stagiaires et commis au quotidien.

VOTRE PROFIL :

• CFC de cuisinier ou diplôme équivalent.

• Minimum 5 ans d’expérience confirmée en tant que Chef de partie dans un restaurant gastronomique étoilé.

• Maîtrise solide des techniques culinaires et des standards gastronomiques.

• Excellente maîtrise des techniques culinaires et compréhension des standards de qualité élevés.

• Capacité avérée à tenir un poste en totale autonomie, avec rigueur et sens des responsabilités.

• Résistance au stress, ponctualité, organisation et esprit d’équipe.

• Excellente présentation et attitude professionnelle.

• De langue maternelle française.

Our Maison’s DNA is defined by five core values. Excellence drives us to be the best at what we do, while Innovation fuels our progress. Respect underpins every interaction, and Integrity shapes our actions. Together, we are One Team , united in serving our clients with unwavering dedication.

As a responsible and supportive employer, we promote a diverse and inclusive work environment for our employees and candidates. Diversity, Equity and Inclusion are woven into the fabric of our Maison’s DNA, and we strive to ensure that our employees can fulfill both their personal and professional aspirations by encouraging internal mobility and individual upskilling programs. We firmly believe that building Diverse Teams contributes to our successes and to deliver on this, we actively embed Diversity, Equity and Inclusion in our business strategy.

It is an exciting time to join our Teams. All applications will be handled in the strictest confidence.

jobs.title: Chargé-e de Comptes Global Custody (80-100%)
jobs.description:
A career at Lombard Odier means working for a renowned global wealth and asset manager, with a strong focus on sustainable investing. An innovative bank of choice for private and institutional clients, our independently owned Firm is one of the best-capitalised banking groups in the world, managing close to CHF 300 billion and operating from over 25 offices across 4 continents.

With a history spanning over 230 years, Lombard Odier is an investment house providing a comprehensive offering of discretionary and advisory portfolio management, wealth services and custody. We also offer asset management services and investment strategies through Lombard Odier Investment Managers and provide advanced banking technology to other financial institutions.

“Rethink Everything” is our philosophy – it is at the heart of everything we do. We have grown stronger through more than 40 financial crises by rethinking the world around us to provide a fresh investment perspective for our clients.

Chargé-e de Comptes Global Custody (80-100%)

Le/la Chargé-e de Clientèle Global Assets est responsable de la gestion opérationnelle d'un portefeuille de clients institutionnels et privés dans le domaine de l'asset servicing. Il assure la mise en place de solutions adaptées aux besoins des clients et la passation d'ordres de bourse. Il joue un rôle clé dans le bon fonctionnement des processus quotidiens et dans l'optimisation de la qualité du service offert en favorisant et facilitant les échanges à travers les différentes équipes de support de la banque.

Votre Mission :

• Gérer les opérations de bourse et de FX, le suivi du settlement, les OST, les paiements, le cash management, les cash flows Private Equity (PE) et consolider des actifs (asset aggregation).

• Veiller à l'exactitude des opérations. Effectuer la saisie des transactions bancaires avec précision et en respectant les délais impartis.

• Ouvrir les comptes et coordonner la mise en place des setup opérationnels avec nos équipes de support et les prestataires tiers. Tenir à jour les dossiers clients, en assurant une documentation complète et précise, en conformité avec les exigences réglementaires et internes.

• Examiner les reportings financiers pour s'assurer de leur exactitude avant transmission aux clients et aux parties prenantes.

• Améliorer le suivi des demandes clients : prioriser, accuser réception, et délivrer les réponses dans des délais optimaux.

• Maintenir une qualité de service irréprochable en restant orienté solution et en démontrant un grand sens du service client.

• Proposer et mettre en œuvre des solutions d'amélioration des processus, tout en veillant à l'efficience de l'équipe.

• Rencontrer et communiquer de manière proactive avec les clients pour s'assurer de leur satisfaction et répondre à leurs besoins spécifiques.

• Établir et maintenir des relations solides avec les gérants et mandataires externes de nos clients.

Votre Profil :

• 3-5 années d'expérience dans le secteur de l'asset servicing, de préférence avec une clientèle institutionnelle et privée.

• Bonne connaissance des opérations financières (bourse, settlements, cash management, PE, fonds transparents).

• Français et anglais courants. Allemand courant serait un atout.

• Capacité à travailler sous pression avec rigueur et méticulosité.

• Überprüfen Sie die Finanzberichterstattung, um die Genauigkeit vor der Übermittlung an Kunden und Stakeholder sicherzustellen.

A career at Lombard Odier means working for a renowned global wealth and asset manager, with a strong focus on sustainable investing. Private Banker Assistant - Milan

As a Private Banker Assistant for our Italian branch, you'll be reporting to the local COO.

YOUR ROLE:

Support Private Bankers with administrative duties pertaining to the clients’ accounts:

• Process transfer orders and deal with client correspondence and all administrative matters

• Ensure appropriate filling/archiving of documentation of all client account documentation

• Liaise with internal service providers within the company to ensure timely and accurate execution/resolution of clients’ request

• Notify Bankers of documentation issues/pending items encountered in the course of the development of business by the Private Bankers

• Deal with the specific mailing for the clients

• Collaborate with internal functions (Compliance, Operations, Legal…) on client onboarding and lifecycle activities

YOUR PROFILE:

• Fluent in English and Italian

• Bachelor Degree Level a plus

• 5-years' experience within financial industry, ideally international

• Experience of direct client interaction and ability to maintain a professional approach

• Organization with ability to prioritize workload accordingly

• Strong collaboration/communication skills

• Ability to work under pressure

• Detailed-oriented

• Client oriented

Our Maison’s DNA is defined by five core values. Excellence drives us to be the best at what we do, while Innovation fuels our progress. Respect underpins every interaction, and Integrity shapes our actions. Together, we are One Team , united in serving our clients with unwavering dedication.

Systems Engineer – Automation (Windows/VMware)

We are looking for a Windows Systems Engineer with a strong passion for automation and infrastructure optimization. You will join a dynamic team of 15 system engineering experts who manage a global infrastructure of more than 7,000 servers. This is a large-scale technical environment where expertise, innovation and advanced automation are at the core of our mission.
You will play a key role in the evolution and standardization of our IT landscape, with a strong focus on PowerShell, VMware Aria/vRealize Automation, and Windows technologies such as Windows Server and Active Directory.
You will be involved in the design, implementation and maintenance of automation solutions aimed at improving operational efficiency and reducing manual intervention.
We actively encourage innovation and the proposal of new ideas to enhance our platforms.
We are currently driving several strategic initiatives, including the upgrade to VMware Cloud Foundation 9 (VCF 9) to modernize our virtualization stack, as well as a next generation observability project based on Elastic solutions.

YOUR ROLE

• Design, develop and maintain advanced PowerShell scripts to automate system administration tasks.

• Deploy, maintain, and optimize VMware Aria / vRealize Automation workflows and blueprints.

• Participate in the administration and evolution of Windows platforms, including Windows Server, Active Directory / ADFS / GPO, SCCM (Microsoft Endpoint Configuration Manager).

• Contribute to the adoption of Infrastructure as Code (IaC) practices.

• Ensure performance, security, and reliability across virtual and physical infrastructure.

• Collaborate closely with network, security, and development teams to integrate automation solutions across the organization.

• Support industrialization efforts, migrations, and continuous improvement projects.

YOUR PROFILE

• Excellent command of Windows Server administration.

• Excellent command of PowerShell (scripting, modules, APIs, end to end automation).

• Good command of VMware Aria / vRealize Automation (vRA, vRO, blueprints, workflows). Knowledge of other Aria suite components is considered an asset.

• Knowledge of virtualization technologies (VMware vSphere).

• Knowledge of Infrastructure as Code (IaC), CI/CD applied to automation, REST APIs, and system integrations

• Experience with Azure, Terraform, GIT and Ansible is considered an asset.

• Strong problem-solving mindset and continuous improvement orientation.

• Ability to work independently in a complex environment.

• Strong service orientation and excellent communication skills.

• Analytical approach and rigorous documentation practices.

The Risk Management Department within Lombard Odier (Europe) S.A. is in charge of the anticipation, identification, measurement, monitoring, control and reporting of all risks to which the bank is or may be exposed, including both Financial Risks and Operational Risks.

In this context, the Risk Management Department monitors existing and emerging risks, assess them and report them to the senior management, the Group and the competent regulators. It supports the business in managing their risks, providing guidance to continuously promote risk awareness.

The Risk Management department is currently looking for a student/trainee for a 6-month period (minimum), starting November 1st. 2026.

The job offers the possibility to acquire a good overview of the organization and the business activity of an international private bank, offering wealth management and related services to High Net Worth Individuals with offices in 6 different markets in Europe and the Head Quarter in Luxembourg.

Candidates will gain a good understanding of the products and processes in a private bank as well as the relevant risk management techniques in a second line of defense control function.

YOUR ROLE:

Contribute to adequate management of the applicable risk type(s) by covering various tasks in the department in close cooperation with the Senior Risk Managers and other control and business functions in the different offices of the Bank (including its Head Office in Switzerland):

• Financial Risks: Contribute to the Bank’s Financial Risk Management and perform relevant periodic and ad hoc controls (mainly credit and liquidity risk related controls);

• Operational Risks: Contribute to administrative tasks in the area of operational incident management, new business initiatives, assistance in Risk and Control Self Assessments, etc);

• General: Assist in administrative tasks in the area of Risk Management;

• LOESA Risk Reporting: Contribute to the monthly LOESA Risk Dashboard and the preparation of the Risk Management Committee meeting and any other internal or external reporting related to Risk Management

YOUR PROFILE:

• Ongoing studies in Master/ BA in Finance, Economics or related areas

• Results-oriented, organisation/ prioritisation of tasks

• Open minded and quick learner

• Rigorous analytical skills

• Good communication skills

• Team player

• Understanding of the financial markets and products

• Basic knowledge of risk management techniques

• IT applications (Excel and Access advanced use)

• Knowledge in macros and/or VBA is an additional advantage

descriptionByLocale.it:
Una carriera a Lombard Odier significa lavorare per un rinomato asset manager globale, con un forte focus sugli investimenti sostenibili. Un'innovativa banca di scelta per clienti privati ed istituzionali, il nostro Studio indipendente di proprietà è uno dei gruppi bancari meglio capitalizzati al mondo, che gestisce quasi 300 miliardi di franchi e opera da oltre 25 uffici in 4 continenti.

Con una storia che dura oltre 230 anni, Lombard Odier è una casa di investimento che offre un'offerta completa di gestione del portafoglio discrezionale e consultivo, servizi di ricchezza e custodia. Offriamo anche servizi di asset management e strategie di investimento attraverso Lombard Odier Investment Manager e fornire tecnologia bancaria avanzata ad altre istituzioni finanziarie.

“Rethink Everything” è la nostra filosofia – è al centro di tutto ciò che facciamo. Siamo cresciuti più forti attraverso più di 40 crisi finanziarie ripensando il mondo intorno a noi per fornire una nuova prospettiva di investimento per i nostri clienti.

Intern Risk Management - Stage di 6 mesi - Lussemburgo

Il Dipartimento di Gestione dei Rischi all'interno di Lombard Odier (Europa) S.A. è responsabile dell'anticipazione, identificazione, misura, monitoraggio, controllo e segnalazione di tutti i rischi a cui la banca è o può essere esposta, compresi i rischi finanziari e i rischi operativi.

In questo contesto, il Risk Management Department monitora i rischi esistenti ed emergenti, li valuta e li segnala alla gestione senior, al Gruppo e ai regolatori competenti. Supporta il business nella gestione dei loro rischi, fornendo indicazioni per promuovere continuamente la consapevolezza del rischio.

Il reparto Gestione del rischio è attualmente alla ricerca di uno studente/treno per un periodo di 6 mesi (minimo), a partire dal 1 novembre 2026.

Il lavoro offre la possibilità di acquisire una buona panoramica dell'organizzazione e dell'attività commerciale di una banca privata internazionale, offrendo la gestione della ricchezza e servizi correlati a High Net Worth Individuals con uffici in 6 diversi mercati in Europa e il Head Quarter in Lussemburgo.

I candidati acquisiranno una buona comprensione dei prodotti e dei processi in una banca privata e le relative tecniche di gestione del rischio in una seconda linea di funzione di controllo della difesa.

IL TUO RUOLO:

Contribuire a una gestione adeguata del tipo di rischio applicabile coprendo varie mansioni del dipartimento in stretta collaborazione con gli Senior Risk Manager e altre funzioni di controllo e di business nei diversi uffici della Banca (compreso il suo Head Office in Svizzera):

• Rischi finanziari: Contribuire alla Gestione del rischio finanziario della Banca e eseguire controlli periodici e ad hoc rilevanti (principalmente controlli relativi al rischio di credito e liquidità);

• Rischi operativi: Contribuire a compiti amministrativi nel settore della gestione degli incidenti operativi, nuove iniziative aziendali, assistenza in Risk and Control Self Assessments, ecc);

• Generale: Assistere nei compiti amministrativi nell'area di Risk Management;

• LOESA Risk Reporting: Contribuisci al mensile LOESA Risk Dashboard e alla preparazione della riunione del comitato di gestione del rischio e di qualsiasi altra segnalazione interna o esterna relativa alla gestione del rischio

Il tuo problema.

• Studi in corso in Master/ BA in Finanza, Economia o aree correlate

• Risultati orientati, organizzazione / priorità dei compiti

• Apri la mente e impara velocemente

• Abilità analitiche rigorose

• Buone capacità di comunicazione

• Giocatore di squadra

• Comprensione dei mercati finanziari e dei prodotti

• Conoscenza di base delle tecniche di gestione del rischio

• Applicazioni IT (Excel e Accesso all'uso avanzato)

• La conoscenza nelle macro e/o VBA è un vantaggio aggiuntivo

• Competenze linguistiche: Inglese e francese obbligatorio. Qualsiasi altra lingua un plus.

Il DNA della nostra Maison è definito da cinque valori fondamentali. L'eccellenza ci spinge ad essere i migliori a quello che facciamo, mentre l'innovazione alimenta i nostri progressi. Il rispetto sostiene ogni interazione, e l'integrità plasma le nostre azioni. Insieme, siamo una squadra unica, uniti nel servire i nostri clienti con inaspettato

Avec une histoire de plus de 230 ans, Lombard Odier est une maison d'investissement offrant une offre complète de gestion de portefeuille discrétionnaire et consultative, de services de patrimoine et de garde. Nous offrons également des services de gestion d'actifs et des stratégies d'investissement par l'intermédiaire de Lombard Odier Investment Managers et fournissons une technologie bancaire avancée à d'autres institutions financières.

Repenser Tout est notre philosophie – elle est au cœur de tout ce que nous faisons. Nous sommes devenus plus forts grâce à plus de 40 crises financières en repensant le monde qui nous entoure pour offrir une nouvelle perspective d'investissement à nos clients.

Gestion des risques des stagiaires - Stage de 6 mois - Luxembourg

Le Département de gestion des risques de Lombard Odier (Europe) S.A. est chargé de l'anticipation, de l'identification, de la mesure, du suivi, du contrôle et de la déclaration de tous les risques auxquels la banque est ou peut être exposée, y compris les risques financiers et les risques opérationnels.

Dans ce contexte, le Département de la gestion des risques surveille les risques existants et émergents, les évalue et en fait rapport à la haute direction, au Groupe et aux organismes de réglementation compétents. Il aide l'entreprise à gérer ses risques en fournissant des conseils pour promouvoir continuellement la sensibilisation aux risques.

Le service de gestion des risques recherche actuellement un étudiant ou un stagiaire pour une période de 6 mois (minimum), à compter du 1er novembre 2026.

L'emploi offre la possibilité d'acquérir une bonne vue d'ensemble de l'organisation et de l'activité commerciale d'une banque privée internationale, offrant des services de gestion de patrimoine et des services connexes aux personnes de haut niveau ayant des bureaux dans 6 marchés différents en Europe et au siège social à Luxembourg.

Les candidats acquerront une bonne compréhension des produits et des processus dans une banque privée ainsi que des techniques pertinentes de gestion des risques dans une deuxième ligne de la fonction de contrôle de la défense.

Votre rôle :

Contribuer à une gestion adéquate du ou des types de risques applicables en couvrant diverses tâches dans le département en étroite collaboration avec les responsables principaux des risques et d'autres fonctions de contrôle et d'affaires dans les différents bureaux de la Banque (y compris son siège social en Suisse):

• Risques financiers : Contribuer à la gestion des risques financiers de la Banque et effectuer des contrôles périodiques et ponctuels pertinents (principalement des contrôles liés au risque de crédit et de liquidité);

• Risques opérationnels : Contribuer aux tâches administratives dans le domaine de la gestion des incidents opérationnels, aux nouvelles initiatives opérationnelles, à l'aide à l'autoévaluation des risques et du contrôle, etc.

• Généralités: Aider à des tâches administratives dans le domaine de la gestion des risques;

• Rapports sur les risques du SAEO : Contribuer au tableau de bord mensuel du SAEO et à la préparation de la réunion du Comité de gestion des risques et de tout autre rapport interne ou externe lié à la gestion des risques

Votre profil :

• Études en cours en Master/ BA en finance, économie ou domaines connexes

• Orientation vers les résultats, organisation/priorisation des tâches

• Apprentissage ouvert et rapide

• Compétences analytiques rigoureuses

• Bonnes compétences en communication

• Joueur de l'équipe

• Compréhension des marchés et produits financiers

• Connaissances de base des techniques de gestion des risques

• Applications informatiques (utilisation avancée Excel et Access)

• La connaissance des macros et/ou de l'ABV est un avantage supplémentaire

• Compétences linguistiques : Anglais et français obligatoires. Toute autre langue a plus.

Le respect sous-tend chaque interaction, et l'intégrité façonne nos actions. Ensemble, nous sommes une équipe, unie pour servir nos clients avec inébranlable

A career at Lombard Odier means working for a renowned global wealth and asset manager, with a strong focus on sustainable investing. Senior AML Compliance Officer (80-100%)

YOUR MISSION:

• Operational due diligence reviews according to CDB standards, FINMA Ordinance and Swiss AML law

• Perform on-boarding, Change of Circumstances and event-triggered reviews of Private Banking clients, especially but not only from/in the Swiss domestic and International Markets. Contribute to Periodic Reviews in peak times

• Develop and write compliance risk assessment with focus on:

• Valutazione operativa a due diligence secondo gli standard CDB, l'Ordinanza FINMA e la legge svizzera AML

• Finalità del conto

• Struttura dell'account

• Sfondo professionale / personale del cliente

• SoW/SoF plausibilità e verifica

• Notizie negative soggette a Crimine Finanziaria o Finanza Terrorista, Sanzioni, PEP o Rischio di Rischio di Risanamento

• Fornire consulenza prospettico e onboard in relazione a potenziali nuovi e preesistenti clienti PEP / High / Medium / Low Risk e agire come centro di competenza per tutte le strutture complesse e PEP relative domande

• Fornire consulenza e supporto, in relazione a tutte le questioni AML, a: Front Office, Customer Lifecycle Management e altre squadre in relazione alle funzioni congiunte

• Lavorare per soddisfare scadenze strette al fine di eseguire le recensioni di conformità richieste in base ai requisiti normativi e aziendali

• Collaborare con il Front Office in modo tempestivo al fine di rispettare i requisiti normativi e politici, considerando gli obiettivi aziendali

• Sostituire l'Onboarding e la revisione della conformità alla testa svizzera con eventuali compiti speciali, tra cui la verifica dei lavori preparatori o di follow-up pertinenti

Il tuo problema.

• 6 - 8 anni di esperienza in Due Diligence e AML recensioni nel settore dei servizi finanziari

• Fluency in francese e inglese è un must con comprensione di qualsiasi altra lingua come bello avere asset

• In qualità di AML Compliance Officer, essendo stato responsabile per i clienti privati di due diligence domande correlate e la copertura di mercato rilevante

• Utilizzato per gestire casi client complessi come High Risk, clienti classificati PEP e strutture complesse

• Avendo un'esperienza approfondita di gestione di vari aspetti della due diligence come AML, CDB, FATCA, Tax e CRS

• Corso di laurea in legge (o equivalente) o prova di simili risultati accademici / di lavoro

• Capacità di riassumere argomenti complessi, di guidare risultati pratici e di prendere decisioni o proposte solide, compresa l'escalation, se del caso, così come la capacità di lavorare bene sotto pressione e contro scadenze brevi

• Capacità di sviluppare e scrivere valutazioni di conformità dettagliate in inglese con cl

• Troubleshoot technical problems and escalate complex issues to the appropriate teams for resolution.

• Maintain comprehensive knowledge of the bank's online banking products, policies, and procedures.

• Keep meticulous records of customer interactions, transactions, and inquiries using our CRM system.

• Collaborate closely with other team members and departments to resolve customer concerns efficiently.

• Support the development of other services as required

• High school diploma or equivalent; bachelor's degree preferred. Hospitality graduates are welcomed.

• Proven experience in a call center or customer service role, preferably in a banking or financial institution.

• Strong understanding of online banking products, functionalities, and processes.

With a history spanning over 230 years, Lombard Odier is an investment house providing a comprehensive offering of discretionary and advisory portfolio management, wealth services and custody. We also offer asset management services and investment strategies through Lombard Odier Investment Managers and provide advanced banking technology to other financial institutions.

“Rethink Everything” is our philosophy – it is at the heart of everything we do. We have grown stronger through more than 40 financial crises by rethinking the world around us to provide a fresh investment perspective for our clients.

Business Risk Manager - Technology & Operations (80-100%)

As part of the Technology & Operations (T&O) Business Risk Management team, you will partner with stakeholders across Operations and Technology to identify key risks, coordinate remediation, and strengthen first‑line ownership of controls. You will contribute to the effective oversight of operational, technology and information risks, and ensure transparent and timely reporting to management.

YOUR ROLE

Risk Identification, Assessment & Reporting

• Identify, assess, and report operational risks, including processing, trade order execution, operational taxes, technology, cybersecurity, and information‑related risks across T&O.

• Support the RCSA process and ensure risk assessments remain current, well‑documented, and evidence‑based.

• Manage the T&O incident process, ensuring incidents are recorded, analysed, escalated, and followed through to closure.

Control Environment Oversight

• Contribute to the T&O Risk Assurance Plan through thematic reviews, independent design and operating effectiveness testing of the control environment, and follow‑up of identified gaps.

• Support the ISAE control framework, ensuring required evidence is collected, complete, and audit‑ready.

Remediation & Issue Management

• Drive, coordinate, and track risk remediation activities, ensuring actions are well defined, owned, and delivered on time.

• Monitor and report on the progression of identified issues, ensuring consistent closure, documentation, and controls uplift.

Governance, Assurance & Culture

• Promote a strong risk culture by supporting awareness, training, and constructive challenge across teams.

• Prepare structured and insightful risk reports to the T&O Risk Committee and senior management.

YOUR PROFILE

• Minimum 5 years' experience in risk management, internal control, audit, or consulting (e.g., Big Four) with focus on operational or technology‑related risks.

• Solid understanding of operations, IT, cybersecurity, and information risk, ideally within financial services.

• Strong analytical mindset with a structured, detail‑oriented approach.

• Excellent communication skills in English and French, with the ability to challenge stakeholders constructively.

• Resident in Switzerland or willingness to relocate

jobs.title: IT Business Analyst – Interbank Messaging (80-100%)
jobs.description:
A career at Lombard Odier means working for a renowned global wealth and asset manager, with a strong focus on sustainable investing. An innovative bank of choice for private and institutional clients, our independently owned Firm is one of the best-capitalised banking groups in the world, managing close to CHF 300 billion and operating from over 25 offices across 4 continents.

With a history spanning over 230 years, Lombard Odier is an investment house providing a comprehensive offering of discretionary and advisory portfolio management, wealth services and custody. We also offer asset management services and investment strategies through Lombard Odier Investment Managers and provide advanced banking technology to other financial institutions.

“Rethink Everything” is our philosophy – it is at the heart of everything we do. We have grown stronger through more than 40 financial crises by rethinking the world around us to provide a fresh investment perspective for our clients.

IT Business Analyst – Interbank Messaging (80-100%)

Lombard Odier group operates its own proprietary banking technology platform, used internally and offered to external financial institutions through a BPO business model. The Technology & Operations (T&O) department is responsible for maintaining and enhancing this platform by delivering robust and scalable solutions to support the Bank’s activities.

As part of the continuous evolution of our Operations Back-Office capabilities, we are looking to strengthen our team with an IT Business Analyst – Interbank Messaging.
The role covers a functional perimeter including interbank messaging, reconciliation processes, and client notifications (account statements, advices). It also provides the opportunity to develop expertise in SWIFT package integration, working at the intersection of business analysis and technical implementation.

We are open to SWIFT package integrators willing to expand their functional knowledge, as well as Business Analysts with a technical background eager to develop integration skills.
You will join the Interbank Messaging Team and work closely with Product Owners, Project Managers, developers, and business stakeholders across Operations and IT.

YOUR ROLE

• Collect, analyze, and formalize business requirements related to interbank messaging (SWIFT), reconciliation, and client notifications.

• Act as the interface between business and IT teams, ensuring shared understanding of needs and constraints.

• Contribute to the design, implementation, and evolution of SWIFT-related solutions (FIN, MT/MX, interfaces).

• Participate in SWIFT package integration (configuration, testing, deployment).

• Define functional specifications, user stories, and acceptance criteria with Product Owners and technical teams by translating business needs into technical requirements

• Ensure end-to-end consistency of messaging flows, including reconciliation and downstream impacts.

• Support incident resolution and root cause analysis.

• Drive continuous improvement of systems, data quality, and processes.

• Maintain documentation and knowledge sharing.

• Monitor SWIFT standards evolution and market practices.

YOUR PROFILE

• Bachelor’s degree in IT, Engineering, or related field (Master’s a plus).

• Experience as a Business Analyst / Technical BA / SWIFT Integrator in payments, securities, or interbank messaging environments.

• Good knowledge of SWIFT standards (MT/MX), reconciliation, and messaging flows.

• Solid understanding of data flows, system integration concepts (SQL, APIs, messaging, data models) and software development tools (Jira, Confluence, ServiceNow)

• Strong communication skills in French & English.

• Analytical mindset with strong problem-solving and prioritization skills.

• Residence in Switzerland or willingness to relocate.

Our Maison’s DNA is defined by five core values. Excellence drives us to be the best at what we do, while Innovation fuels our progress. Respect und

jobs.title: Sustainability Research Analyst
jobs.description:
A career at Lombard Odier means working for a renowned global wealth and asset manager, with a strong focus on sustainable investing. An innovative bank of choice for private and institutional clients, our independently owned Firm is one of the best-capitalised banking groups in the world, managing close to CHF 300 billion and operating from over 25 offices across 4 continents.

With a history spanning over 230 years, Lombard Odier is an investment house providing a comprehensive offering of discretionary and advisory portfolio management, wealth services and custody. We also offer asset management services and investment strategies through Lombard Odier Investment Managers and provide advanced banking technology to other financial institutions.

“Rethink Everything” is our philosophy – it is at the heart of everything we do. We have grown stronger through more than 40 financial crises by rethinking the world around us to provide a fresh investment perspective for our clients.

Working within the Sustainable Investing team, the Sustainability Research Analyst will play an integral role in the implementation, development and ongoing enhancement of Lombard Odier’s proprietary sustainable investment framework. By ensuring credibility and consistency, this function is central to the firm’s sustainable investment offering and entails interactions with investment teams and other internal stakeholders across the firm’s asset management and private banking activities. Initial responsibilities will focus on the application of the framework to sustainability assessments, with scope over time to take ownership of specific workstreams related to the framework’s development and implementation.

Sustainability Research Analyst (80-100%)

Your Role :

• Assess companies and labelled debt instruments against the firm’s proprietary sustainable investment framework using company disclosures, third-party sustainability data, and other external sources; author written assessments for internal and client-facing use

• Contribute to the continued development of qualitative framework criteria through sector and value chain research; support improvements to data-driven framework criteria by leveraging external datasets and internal tools.

• Monitor developments in sustainability regulation, standards, frameworks, and emerging sustainability themes

• Work with investment teams and other internal stakeholders to explain assessment outputs, support new investment ideas and respond to sustainability-related due diligence or client requests

• Contribute to improving workflows and documentation related to the sustainable investment framework and investment processes, including through the introduction of AI-enabled workflows

• Generate research insights and collaborate with the investment stewardship team on company engagement

Your Profile :

• Degree or postgraduate qualification in sustainability, environmental science, public policy or a related field; sustainability-focused professional experience may substitute for a sustainability-specific academic background

• Prior experience in sustainability/ESG research, sustainability consulting, sustainable finance, or sustainable capital markets

• Demonstrated experience analysing companies, sectors, business models and corporate disclosures from the perspective of sustainability-related risks, opportunities and impacts

• Strong understanding of environmental and social sustainability issues and their interconnections, as well as sustainability frameworks, certifications and standards

• Intellectual curiosity and the ability to think conceptually about the intersections of financial markets, corporate performance, and environmental and social issues

• Comfort with ambiguity and making judgments with incomplete or imperfect data

• Ability to interpret and organise complex qualitative and quantitative information

• Ability to work independently and take ownership of projects

Garantire credibilità e coerenza, questa funzione è fondamentale per l’offerta di investimento sostenibile dell’azienda e comporta interazioni con i team di investimento e altri stakeholder interni attraverso la gestione patrimoniale e le attività bancarie private. Le responsabilità iniziali si concentreranno sull’applicazione del quadro alle valutazioni di sostenibilità, con lo scopo nel tempo di prendere possesso di specifici flussi di lavoro relativi allo sviluppo e all’attuazione del quadro.

Analista di ricerca di sostenibilità (80-100%)

Il tuo ruolo:

• Valutare le aziende e etichettare gli strumenti di debito contro il framework di investimento sostenibile proprietario dell’azienda utilizzando le informative aziendali, i dati di sostenibilità di terzi e altre fonti esterne; autorizzare valutazioni scritte per l’uso interno e client-facing

• Contribuire al continuo sviluppo di criteri quadro qualitativi attraverso la ricerca nel settore e nella catena del valore; sostenere i miglioramenti ai criteri di framework basati sui dati sfruttando i set di dati esterni e gli strumenti interni.
